questions.question: Q: Explain two Christian beliefs about salvation.

points.text: 1) Salvation through grace — Christians believe that humans cannot earn salvation through their own efforts; it is a free gift from God, received through faith (Ephesians 2:8-9). 2) Salvation through Christ's atonement — Jesus' death on the cross paid the penalty for sin, making it possible for humans to be reconciled with God. questions.question: Q: "People can be good without God." Evaluate this statement with reference to Christian teaching.

points.text: Many would agree that non-religious people can live morally good lives, showing kindness, justice and compassion. However, from a Christian perspective, true goodness comes from God, and without God there is no ultimate standard of morality.
